simple.meaning: seed ; figuratively, fruit , plant , sowing-time , posterity
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to זֶרַע (H2233) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 229 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.

definitions.full: H2233. zera זֶ֫רַע noun masculine Deut 28:38 sowing, seed, offspring (Late Hebrew id. , Aramaic זְרַע , ; Phoenician זרע ; Zinjirli id. ; Arabic seed-produce, seed ; Ethiopic Assyrian zêru , cultivated land , Belser BAS ii. 130, compare Arabic ) — absolute ׳ז Gen 47:23 =; זָ֑רַע 1:29 +; construct זֶרַע Isa 5:10 +; זְרַעֿ Num 11:7 ; suffix זַרְעִי 1Sam 20:42 ; 24:22 ; זַרְעֲךָ Deut 11:10 +; זַרְעֶ֑ךָ Eccl 11:6 +; etc.; plural suffix זַרְעֵיכֶם 1Sam 8:15 ; — 1 literal: a. a sowing ׳לְז הַשָּׂדֶה Gen 47:24 (J; + אָכְלְכֶם ; otherwise Lev 27:16 b, see below 2c ); ז מְקוֺם ׳לֹא Num 20:5 no place for sowing (J E; + וְרִמּוֺן וְגֶפֶן וּתְאֵנָה ); compare ז ׳שְׂדֵה Ezek 17:5 a field suitable for sowing ; hence b. sowing as regularly recurring at its season Gen 8:22 (J; || קָצִיר , + וָלַיְלָה וְיוֺם וָחֹרֶף וְקַיִץ וָחֹם קֹר ), Lev 26:5 (H; || בָּצִיר דַּיִשׁ, ; — compare Amos 9:13 below 2a ). 2 seed: a. literally, sown, to raise crops for food, usually corn (wheat, barely, etc.) Gen 47:19 , 23 (J; compare 47:14 f.), Num 24:7 (JE); ׳ז לַֹזּרֵעַ נָתַן Isa 55:10 (|| לֶחֶם ), Deut 28:38 ( ׳ז רַב ), Lev 26:16 (H; with זָרַע ), 27:16 a, ׳ז שְׂעֹרִים חֹמֶר 27:16 b (both P), compare Isa 5:10 . b. figurative, of idolatry of Judah Isa 17:11 (|| קציר ); of fortunes of Zion הַזּ ׳מֶשֶׁךְ Psa 126:6 the dropping of seed , i.e. the proper quantity for sowing (opposed to אֲלֻמֹּת ); Jer 35:7 (with זָרַע , || תִטָּ֔עוּ לֹא כֶּרֶם ), compare 35:9 (|| שׂדה כרם, ); ז ׳מְטַר Isa 30:23 (with זָרַע , || הָאֲדָמָה תְּבוּאַתּ לֶחֶם ); also Deut 11:10 (with זָרַע ), Eccl 11:6 (c. id. ); ׳ז זֵרוּעַ Lev 11:37 , compare 11:38 (both P); as yielding the crop זַרְעֶ֑ךָ תְּבוּאַת Deut 14:22 the product of thy seed , compare d. below; הַזּ בְּמשֵׁךְ עֲנָבִים וְדֹרֵךְ בַּקּוֺצֵר תוֺרֵשׁ ׳וְנִגַּשׁ Amos 9:13 , in figure of rapid and plentiful growth in the coming time; ׳ז הָאָרֶץ producing a vine Ezek 17:5 , of growth and prosperity of Israel; ׳הַזּ Mal 2:3 , read perhaps הַזְּרֹעַ (compare VB). c. seed as product; the manna is compare with ׳ז גַּד , coriander seed Num 11:7 (JE), Exod 16:31 (P); seed of herbs and trees Gen 1:11 (twice in verse); 1:12 (twice in verse); 1:29 (twice in verse) (all P). Especially d. seed as corn-product, corn-crop , so (although not quite clearly) Deut 22:9 (with זָרַע ; || הַכָּ֑רֶם תְּבוּאַת ); plural 1Sam 8:15 (perhaps better arable lands , compare above As zêru ; || כרמים ), ׳ז הָאָרֶץ Lev 27:30 (|| מְּרִיעֵֿץ ; otherwise Gen 47:24 , compare above 1a ); ׳ז שִׁחֹר Isa 23:3 (|| יְאוֺר קְצִיר ); הַזּ ׳הַעוֺד בַּמְּגוּרָה Hag 2:19 (|| הַזַּיִת עֵץ רִמּוֺן, תְּאֵנָה, גֶּפֶן, ); יֶאֱסֹף וְגָרְנְךָ זַרְעֶ֑ךָ יָשִׁו֯ב Job 39:12 (of harvest); so perhaps ז סָאתַיִם ׳כְּבֵית 1Kin 18:32 . e. הַגֶּפֶן הַשָּׁלוֺם זֶרַע Zech 8:12 , read perhaps ׳הַזּ שׁלוֺם the crop is security (= secure), so ᵑ6 Or and others; > Ew Hi and others who translate ׳ז ׳הַשּׁ the growth of peace , making הַגֶּמֶּן appositive — Verbs used with ׳ז in these senses are: — usually זַרַע Gen 1:11 ; Lev 26:16 ; Jer 35:7 +; הִפְרִיחַ Isa 17:11 ; בְּ נָתַן = plant, sow Ezek 17:5 ; נָתַן yield Isa 55:10 ; מָשַׁךְ Amos 9:13 . 3 seed = semen virile, זָ֑רַע וְנִזְרְעָה Num 5:28 , and she shall be made pregnant with seed ; usually ׳שִׁכְּבַתזֿ , flow of semen Lev 22:4 (H), 15:16 , 32 (P; all with תֵּצֵא ), 15:17 (P; with הָיָה ); as accusative modi שׁ ׳אתאִֿשָּׁה ׳ז שׁכב 19:20 (H), 15:18 ; Num 5:13 (both P); so also לְזרע שְׁכָבְתּוֺ נתן Lev 18:20 ( לְ Genitives); compare ׳ז וז ׳אָדָם בְּהֵמָה Jer 31:27 (as 2nd accusative after זָרַע q. v. 3b ). 4 seed = off spring: a. rarely of animals , collective Gen 3:15 ; 7:3 (both J). Usu. b. of mankind, coll . = descendants, posterity; seed of the woman Gen 3:15 (J); seed of the patriarchs (especially Abraham) 12:17 ; 13:15-16 , (twice in verse); 16:10 ; 22:17 (twice in verse); 22:18 ; 24:7 ; 26:3-4 , (3 t. in verse); 26:24 ; 28:13-14 , (twice in verse); 32:13 (all J), 15:13 , 18 ; Exod 32:13 (twice in verse); 33:1 (all J E), Gen 21:12 ; Josh 24:3 (both E; in both promised seed of Abraham restricted to line of Isaac), Deut 11:9 ; 34:4 ; Neh 9:8 ; = a son as involving posterity Gen 15:3 , 5 (JE) compare below; phrase אַחֲרֵיהֶם זַרְעָם Deut 1:8 , compare 4:37 ; 10:15 , so P, Gen 17:7 (twice in verse); 17:8-9 , 10 , 19 ; 35:12 ; 48:4 ; אִתָּךְ זִרְעֲךָ 28:4 (P; compare Num 18:19 ); see also below c. seed (= posterity) of other individuals Gen 21:13 (E; of Ishmael) 24:60 ; 48:19 (both J), Num 14:24 (JE), Lev 21:21 ; 22:3-4 , (all H), Num 17:5 (P), 1Sam 20:42 (twice in verse); 24:22 ; 2Sam 4:8 ; 1Kin 2:33 (twice in verse); 11:39 ; 2Kin 5:27 ; Jer 29:32 ; Ezek 43:19 ; Job 5:25 (|| צֶאֱצָאֶיךָ ), 21:8 (|| id. ); especially of seed of David as anointed to reign Psalm 18:51 = 2Sam 22:51 (|| לִמְשִׁיחוֺ ), as sitting on throne Jer 33:21 , compare 33:22 ; 33:26 , Psa 89:5 ; 89:30 ; 89:37 ; of Jehoiachin Jer 22:28 , 30 , Jehoiakim 36:31 (compare 36:30 ); of child (son) as involving posterity Gen 38:8-9 , (twice in verse) (of Er's seed by Onam); 48:11 (all J), compare 19:32 , 31 (J), 2Sam 7:12 ; Ruth 4:12 ; Lev 21:15 (H); phrase אַחֲרֵיהֶם זַרְעָם of seed of Noah and his sons Gen 9:9 ; of Aaron Exod 28:43 ; of Phinehas Num 25:13 (all P); of David 1Chr 17:11 ; לְדֹרֹתָם לְזַרְעוֺ Exod 30:21 (P), compare Lev 21:17 (H; both of Aaron), see also b above ׳ז , of seed of righteous, especially Psalms: — Psa 25:13 ; 37:25-26 , Psalm 69:37; Psalm 102:29 (|| בָּנִים ), 112:2 (|| ישׁרים דּוֺר ), compare 22:31 (on text see Che); of wicked 21:11 ; 37:28 . d. specifically of a particular child (son) ׳ז אַחֵר Gen 4:25 (J); ׳ז אֲנָשִׁים 1Sam 1:11 ; of children Lev 18:21 ; 20:2 ; Leviticus 20:34; 22:13 (all H), 1Sam 2:20 (compare בָּנוֺת בָּנִים, 2:21 ); children and grandchildren Gen 46:6-7 , (P). e. family Gen 17:12 (P; compare Assyrian zêr bit abišu Asrb Annals iii. 10 ); note especially of royal family ׳ז הַמֶּלֶךְ 1Kin 11:14 ; ׳ז הַמַּמְלָכָה 2Kin 11:1 2Chr 22:10 ; ׳ז הַמְּלוּכָה 2Kin 25:25 = Jer 41:1 ; Ezek 17:13 ; Dan 1:3 ; = pedigree וְזַרְעָם אבותם בית Ezra 2:59 = Neh 7:61 ; = one's nation , as of same blood Est 10:3 (|| עַם ). — Some verbs used with ׳ז in these senses are: — נָתַן , God subject Gen 15:3 ; Ruth 4:12 (followed by מִן of woman); שִׂים 1Sam 2:20 ; with man as subject נתן Gen 38:9 ; הֵקִים 38:8 ; ז ׳חִיָּה , keep alive , or give life to , of animals 7:3 ; of woman 19:32 , 34 (followed by מִן of man). f. especially as name for people of Israel, seed of Abraham Isa 41:8 ; 2Chr 20:7 (|| יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמְּךָ ), Jer 33:26 ; Psa 105:6 (|| יעקִב בְּנֵי ); of Israel or Jacob 2Kin 17:20 ; Neh 9:2 (|| ישׂראל בני 9:1 ), Isa 43:5 ; 45:19 , 25 ; Jer 31:36-37 , 33:26 ; Psa 22:24 (twice in verse); 1Chr 16:13 (|| יעקב בני ); so ׳ז ישׂראל בֵּית Jer 23:8 ; Ezek 44:22 ( ᵐ5 ᵑ6 Manuscripts Co strike out בית ); יעקב ׳ז בית 20:5 ; in Esther. ׳ז הַיְהוּדִים Est 6:13 ; so of Edom (seed of Esau) Jer 49:10 , compare מָדַי מִוֶּרע Dan 9:1 . g. seed of Israel (or Jacob, or the people), is used also, by (later) prophets, of future Generations , in addressing the people: — Deut 28:46 , 59 ; 30:6 , 19 ; 31:21 , compare Num 18:19 (P; אִתָּ֑ךְ לְזַרְעֲךָ , || וְלִבְנוֺתֶיךָ וּלְבָנֶיךָ ), Jer 30:10 = 46:27 (Jacob and Israel here = people), Psa 106:27 ; || ׅ צֶאֱצָא(יך Isa 44:3 (Jacob and Jeshurun), 48:19 , compare 61:9 ; also Jer 7:15 ; Isa 54:3 ; 66:22 (|| שִׁמְכֶם ); זַרְעֲךָ זֶרַע וּמִמִּי זַרְעֲךָ מִמִּי 59:21 ; of Jews ( יהודים ) Est 9:27-28 , 31 . 5 seed as marked by moral quality = persons (or community) of such a quality; transition to this through such cases as those of ׳ז י ׳בְּרוּכֵי Isa 65:23 (|| צֶאֱצָאִים ), compare 61:9 ; 65:9 ; ׳ז הַקֹּדֶשׁ Ezra 9:2 (of Israel), compare Isa 53:10 ; note, in good sense ׳ז צַדִּיקִים Prov 11:21 (opposed to רַע ); ׳ז אֱמֶת Jer 2:21 (|| שׂוֺרֵק ); ׳ז אלהים Mal 2:15 ; — ׳ז קֹדֶשׁ Isa 6:13 is a gloss; — in bad sense ׳ז מְרֵעִים 1:4 community of evil-doers (|| מַשְׁחִיתִים בָּנִים עָוֺן, כֶּבֶד עַם גּוֺיחֹֿטֵא, ), 14:20 ; ׳ז מְנָאֵף 57:3 (|| עֹנֲנָה בני ); שָֿׁ֑קֶר׳ז 57:4 (|| יִלְדֵיפֶֿשַׁע ).
